### Details

The installer moved an existing same-version copy into staging/damaged before publishing its replacement. A blocked rollback preserves both the concurrent destination and the old backup across reclamation and reports the recovery path. A valid retained replacement allows later backup cleanup; ordinary retry publication succeeds.

**Validation:** Two persistence invariants run through the production installer and reclaimer using real directories, binaries, hashes and receipts.
